```suggestion:-0+0

set( EXTRA_CNF
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/../x509if/x509if-exp.cnf"
)

```

Since this imports from x509if, it needs to ensure that x509if-exp.cnf is built when regenerating the dissector. (Lots of other dissectors depend on x509if, so this only makes a difference when the built code is clean and this dissector is the only dirty source.)

Not sure how to get the clang build to pas.

Clang-Tidy found three recursive call chains:

> packet-cosem.c:2080:1: error: function 'dlms_get_type_description_length' is within a recursive call chain [misc-no-recursion,-warnings-as-errors]

dlms_get_type_description_length calls itself.

> packet-cosem.c:2109:1: error: function 'dlms_dissect_compact_array_content' is within a recursive call chain [misc-no-recursion,-warnings-as-errors]

dlms_dissect_compact_array_content calls itself.

> packet-cosem.c:2152:1: error: function 'dlms_dissect_data' is within a recursive call chain [misc-no-recursion,-warnings-as-errors]

dlms_dissect_data calls itself.

In each case you need to ensure that the recursion stops, either naturally or by adding `increment_dissection_depth()` and `decrement_dissection_depth()` where needed. That appears to be done, but unfortunately Clang-Tidy doesn't seem to be able to detect recursion guards.

Until that happens you need to add `NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion)` [Clang-Tidy suppressions](https://clang.llvm.org/extra/clang-tidy/#suppressing-undesired-diagnostics) before each function. There are examples in a bunch of dissectors, e.g. packet-tcap.c

// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion) was the missing piece I think.
Thanks!

+  if (actx->external.direct_ref_present) {
+    offset=call_ber_oid_callback(actx->external.direct_reference, tvb, offset, actx->pinfo, actx->subtree.top_tree, actx->private_data);
